quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on LeBron James's impact in the game
quotes.excerpt: The whole thing started off with LeBron James hitting two holacious shots out of the corner
quotes.quote: The whole thing started off with LeBron James hitting two holacious shots out of the corner, right up in our guys' grill when we were playing good defense. So some nights it's like that, and I don't like the way this game went. I know we can play a lot better, I know we can compete a lot better, but it happened and it's over and now we got to turn toward tomorrow.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on upcoming game against the Chicago Bulls
quotes.excerpt: Chicago is playing well and they're off of a big win in Charlotte
quotes.quote: Chicago is playing well and they're off of a big win in Charlotte and they didn't have Jalen Smith playing, who's one of their best players this year. So they'll be loaded up and they've been through rough stretches as well. So, you know, we're going to have to be ready to fight them.
